note: Ready-made mock CQC inspections for a CQC-registered home care provider. Each template lists quality statements of the active CQC framework (single assessment framework v1) and, where useful, what to focus on. Guidance is CareFlow's own wording, not CQC's text. CQC's draft adult social care framework (March 2026, 24 key lines of enquiry, no numerical scores) was not yet in force when this was written; when it is, the templates move to its statements through the framework's mapsFrom links.
